CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_count()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(private.current_role() in ('student','lead','admin','mentor'),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_create_assigned_lead_location()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from public.profiles p
  join auth.users u on u.id=p.id
  join public.team_member_positions mp on mp.user_id=p.id and mp.revoked_at is null
  join public.team_positions pos on pos.key=mp.position_key and pos.active
  where p.id=auth.uid() and p.active and p.role::text in ('student','lead')
   and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and u.last_sign_in_at is not null
   and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now())
   and not exists(select 1 from public.team_attendance_members m where m.student_id=p.id and m.member_status='inactive')
   and pos.key in ('business_lead','cad_lead','communications_lead','fabrication_lead','finance_lead',
    'operations_lead','power_lead','software_lead','strategy_lead','program_manager','product_technical_manager')
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_create_item(area uuid)

     or coalesce(private.can_edit(area),false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_edit(area uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
 select private.is_admin() or (private.current_role()='lead' and area=private.current_area())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_manage_media(kind text, entity uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when kind='items' then exists(select 1 from public.inventory_items where id=entity and coalesce(private.can_edit(area_id),false))
 when kind='locations' then exists(select 1 from public.locations where id=entity and (private.is_admin() or (private.current_role()='lead' and area_id=private.current_area()))) else false end
$function$
